component.name: PrivilegedBridge
component.summary: Controlled access to approved privileged Linux operations

description.p: PrivilegedBridge provides a secure, allowlisted command-line interface between local AI agents and approved Linux system operations.
It allows AI-assisted automation without granting unrestricted root shell access. Privileged actions are predefined and authorization is handled through controlled system mechanisms.
Initial PrivilegedBridge release with allowlisted local AI system operations.
